title: Validate UTF-8 across input chunks
audience: Students with basic programming knowledge learning assembly
prerequisites: Byte-oriented records and logical input bounds
Persistent state and saved-register calling conventions
Unsigned byte interpretation and bit fields
learningObjectives: Preserve continuation bounds across chunk boundaries
Separate sequence start from detecting offset
Distinguish nonfinal prefix from final truncation
Latch terminal states without later input access
Compare branch and lookup classification without changing behavior

progression.localImplementation: Native prose and worked traces, incremental assembly edits, and callable CLI streaming checks
